en.headline: 14 own commits plus 28 automated; 3 issues and 1 discussion on OpenCode
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **14 own commits** across two personal repos, plus 28 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (7 commits) the work was documentation: adding `AGENTS.md`, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing knowledge to cover all topics, archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth and Windows path notes, and recording oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode findings. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (7 commits) the daily CLI gained a `--force` flag to skip the comment-count snapshot freeze and re-fetch finalized days, a 30-day GitHub activity AI summary was added as a homepage card plus standalone page, candidate entries stopped filtering on `updated_at` window membership, `lib/days.mjs` was extracted as a shared helper, comment-count scope and target lookup were tightened per review, and a +08 early-morning reply-collection gap was fixed with comment counts now shown on Issue/PR rows. On issues, 3 items were opened or commented on in `anomalyco/opencode`: opened #55785 (Go endpoint rejects image input for mimo-v2.6-flash / mimo-v2.5 with 400) and #55772 (Windows desktop ships the CLI but no way to run it), and commented on #55785.

zh.headline: 14 次本人提交加 28 次自动提交；3 个 issue 与 1 个讨论
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在两个个人仓库共完成 **14 次本人提交**，另有 28 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 7 次提交均为文档工作：新增 `AGENTS.md`、建立 `knowledge/` 目录归档 Git & GitHub 发现并附 Excalidraw 草图、将 knowledge 泛化为各类知识、归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑、以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 7 次提交中，daily CLI 新增 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结并重取定稿日数据，新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结（首页卡片加独立页），候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤，抽出 `lib/days.mjs` 作为共享助手，按复审意见收紧评论数口径与 target 检索，并修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复、在 Issue/PR 行显示评论数。issue 方面在 `anomalyco/opencode` 新开或评论共 3 项：新开 #55785（Go 端点对 mimo-v2.6-flash / mimo-v2.5 的图片输入一律返回 400）与 #55772（Windows 桌面版附带 CLI 却无运行方式），并在 #55785 上留言。收到的回复包括 `micahgerges` 在 #55785 的两条跟进（基于 opencode serve 2.0.29 真实密钥部署与 2x2 对照测试），以及 `opencode-agent[bot]` 对 #55785 和 #55772 的回复。另开启 1 个讨论：`openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4982，标题为 "Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients"。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release。
